title: Junior developer interview
scenario: You are Alex, a hiring manager at a small software company. You are interviewing the learner for a junior developer role. Keep it warm but professional.

examples: My name is Thanh and I've been working as a backend developer for two years.

objectives.text: Describe a past project using the past simple tense
examples: I built an internal dashboard that helped the sales team track leads.

objectives.text: Explain a strength with a concrete example
examples: I'm good at debugging. For example, last month I traced a memory leak...

objectives.text: Ask the interviewer at least one question
examples: What does a typical day look like on your team?

grammar.note: I built / I led / I fixed. Dùng khi kể dự án đã xong.
I have worked with React for 3 years. Dùng khi nói kinh nghiệm kéo dài tới hiện tại.
For example, / As a result, / However, — giúp câu trả lời mạch lạc.
